## Job details
PAL Technical Services is a leader in international aerospace and defense design, development and operation of airborne surveillance aircraft, line maintenance, heavy maintenance checks and modifications. We provide a wide range of aviation and related services to domestic and international markets.PAL Technical Services is currently seeking a Full-Time Utility Personnel to join our team in St. John's, NL. Duties & Responsibilities: Basic Hangar clean up.Hangar maintenance and general housekeeping duties.Maintenance workshop duties related to aircraft parts and materials.Aircraft freight delivery and pickup.Assist with aircraft towing responsibilities. Refuel ground support equipment; ground power unit, MTC truck and van.Carry out weekly inspections of ground and hangar equipment including ladder inspections.Carry out weekly Hangar Safety Inspections. Qualifications: Completion of High School.The ability to work with minimal supervision and be self-motivated to perform and complete assigned tasks.A strong commitment to safety, adhering to all safe work environment standards and procedures.Must be willing to work outside in all types of weather and elevated noise levels within the aircraft environment.Must be able to stand, lift and bend for extended periods of time, as well as lifting weight up to 50lbs.The ability to work well in a team environment, with strong communication and problem solving skills.Valid Driver's License, with clean Driver's Abstract.Must be able to obtain the following:A RAIC (Restricted Area Identification Card).An AVOP - Type D (Airside Vehicle Operator's Permit) (Preference will be given to candidates who already have an AVOP). A Security Clearance, which includes a check of your last 5 years of employment and criminal record history. What We Offer to our PALs: Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental, vision, and life insurance.Defined Contribution Pension Plan.Employee Stock Purchase Plan.Employee Tuition Assistance Program.Employee and Family Assistance Program.Personal travel privileges with PAL and interline agreements with multiple airlines.
